 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Los Angeles Lakers (7-2) will host the Portland Trail Blazers (6-1) in the NBA Cup tonight. Tipoff is set for 10:00 p.m. ET from Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, California. The game will broadcast live on Amazon Prime Video.
 The Lakers are 3.5-point favorites over the Blazers on the spread, with the total set at over/under 231.5 points. Los Angeles is a -156 moneyline favorite to win outright, while Portland is a +132 underdog to pull off the upset.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Let's get into my Trail Blazers vs. Lakers predictions and NBA picks for Friday, November 6.

 Portland Trail Blazers vs Los Angeles Lakers Betting Preview
 Trail Blazers Betting Preview: The Problem With Drop Coverage
 The Portland Trail Blazers are a fascinating team defensively because they are militant about playing drop coverage.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Blazers are absolutely dedicated to it, primarily because they want to keep Donovan Clingan anchored near the rim where he excels, rather than pulling him out to the perimeter.
 Because of this strict drop scheme, the Blazers' wings are able to stay home on shooters. However, the fatal flaw of this coverage is that they surrender the highest number of three-point attempts off the pick-and-roll in the entire NBA. They allow opposing ball-handlers to walk right into pull-up jumpers.
 The Blazers might be holding teams to 29 percent on those looks, but when you face a high-usage star like Luka Doncic, that volume is going to burn you.
 Lakers Betting Preview: The Luka Doncic Show
 The Los Angeles Lakers offense completely revolves around Luka Doncic, and he is playing at an MVP -caliber level right now.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Luka's plus-minus numbers are staggering; when he is on the court, the Lakers are amazing, and when he sits, they are a huge negative.
 Austin Reaves hasn't looked quite like himself lately, which means even more of the offensive burden falls directly on Luka's shoulders.
 We also know that Luka tends to take a step forward in these NBA Cup tournament games.
 Doncic also just dropped a massive 41-point performance on this exact same Portland team a couple of weeks ago, and the Lakers desperately need this win.
 Trail Blazers vs Lakers Best Bets, Analysis
 I know this line looks ridiculous on the surface—it reminds me of the days when James Harden was getting lines of 39.5—but Luka has been on another planet this season. He has cleared this number in six straight games.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The sheer volume of three-pointers he is taking is outrageous; over his last few games, he's logged 13, 15, 12, 16, 15, and 18 attempts from deep.
 Portland's drop coverage is practically begging ball-dominant guards to pull up from deep, which is exactly why guys like Devin Booker, Jamal Murray, and Darius Acuff have all gone off against them.
 Luka is going to get whatever he wants out of the pick-and-roll tonight.
 Pick: Luka Doncic Over 34.5 Points (-122)
